# ROI area extraction
```{r}
folder <- "data/Xen2_ROIs/Xen2_KO_Vessels/28d"

files <- list.files(
  folder,
  pattern = "_cells_stats\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

extract_area <- function(file) {
  dat <- read.csv(
    file,
    header = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  area_text <- dat[2, 1]
  
  # Extract number after ":"
  area <- as.numeric(
    sub(".*:\\s*", "", area_text)
  )
  
  return(area)
}

results <- data.frame(
  file = basename(files),
  area_um2 = sapply(files, extract_area)
)

# View individual measurements
print(results)

# Calculate summary statistics
mean_area <- mean(results$area_um2, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_area <- sd(results$area_um2, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Number of samples:", nrow(results), "\n")
cat("Mean tissue area:", sprintf("%.2f", mean_area), "µm²\n")
cat("Standard deviation:", sprintf("%.2f", sd_area), "µm²\n")
```
